scenes.vo_line: Did you know? The hamburger wasn't actually invented in Hamburg, Germany.
The real origin story is a fierce historical debate between multiple countries claiming they invented it first.
America claims the honor with Louis' Lunch in Connecticut serving the first hamburger in 1900.
But Hamburg, Germany argues their 'steak tartare' — raw minced beef — was the inspiration behind the beef patty.
The name 'hamburger' likely comes from Hamburg immigrants who brought their beef preparation methods to America.
The first hamburger bun wasn't introduced until the 1904 World's Fair in St. Louis — before that, burgers were eaten with bread slices.
Which fact surprised you most? Follow for more incredible food history and burger facts you never knew!
